'''Amadaine 23 (July 1)'''

==Events==
* [[998 NE]] - [[Rand]] receives invitations from [[Barthanes Damodred]] and [[Galldrian Riatin]]. The inn is set on fire and the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]] and [[Ruby-hilted dagger|dagger]] stolen again. [[Hurin]] tracks the [[Darkfriends]] to Barthanes' manor.
* [[999 NE]] - Rand arrives at [[Alcair Dal]] and is accepted as the ''[[Car'a'carn]]'' after revealing the true history of the [[Aiel]]. He chases [[Asmodean]] to [[Rhuidean]] and defeats him. [[Lanfear]] [[shield]]s Asmodean and leaves him to serve as a teacher for Rand.
</noinclude>
